Proof in the paper: The structural features of as-prepared MOFs were characterized by the XRD technique (Figure 3a). The results verified that Co-MOF, CoFe-MOF, and Fe-MOF samples have a similar structure, consistent with the simulated phase of diaqua-bis(5-carboxy-1H-imidazole-4-carboxylate)cobalt(II) (CCDC no. 998828).
